/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Massachusetts
    Focus year: 2021

    Question:
    "Is the term 'Writ of restitution' used to refer to the order from the court
     to the authorities to remove a tenant?"

    Statutes provided (only):
    [1] MA Gen L ch 281  3 (2021)
*/

% ---------------------------
% Basic domain vocabulary
% ---------------------------

state(massachusetts).
focus_year(2021).

% Represent the queried term and meaning as atoms.
term(writ_of_restitution).
meaning(order_from_court_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant).

% ---------------------------
% Statute translation
% ---------------------------

/*
  MA Gen L ch 281  3 (2021)
  "The repeal of a law by this act shall not revive a law heretofore repealed or
   superseded, nor an office heretofore abolished."
*/

% Encodes the legal effect: repeal does not revive previously repealed/superseded law.
% (MA Gen L ch 281  3 (2021))
statute_ma_ch281_s3_no_revival_of_previously_repealed_law(massachusetts, 2021).

% Encodes the legal effect: repeal does not revive previously abolished offices.
% (MA Gen L ch 281  3 (2021))
statute_ma_ch281_s3_no_revival_of_previously_abolished_office(massachusetts, 2021).

% For reasoning about "term used to refer to meaning", we must model what the provided
% statutes define or use. The provided statute does not mention "writ of restitution"
% (or eviction orders), so we encode an empty "mention/definition" set for this statute.

% statute_mentions_term(+State,+Year,+StatuteId,+Term)
% No clauses are provided that would succeed for writ_of_restitution under the given statute.
% (Intentionally left without any facts to reflect the statute text.)
statute_mentions_term(_State, _Year, _StatuteId, _Term) :-
    fail.

% statute_defines_term_as_meaning(+State,+Year,+Term,+Meaning)
% No term definitions are present in the provided statute text.
statute_defines_term_as_meaning(_State, _Year, _Term, _Meaning) :-
    fail.

% ---------------------------
% Scenario (question statement) translation
% ---------------------------

% The scenario is simply the inquiry about whether a term is used to refer to a meaning,
% under Massachusetts law in 2021, based ONLY on the provided statutes.
scenario_state(massachusetts).
scenario_year(2021).
scenario_term(writ_of_restitution).
scenario_meaning(order_from_court_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the factual statement of the scenario is satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_year(Year),
    scenario_term(Term),
    scenario_meaning(Meaning),
    state(State),
    focus_year(Year),
    term(Term),
    meaning(Meaning).

% ---------------------------
% Legal reasoning
% ---------------------------

% A term is "used to refer to" a meaning if, in the provided statutory material for that
% jurisdiction/year, the term is defined as that meaning.
legal_term_used_for_meaning(State, Year, Term, Meaning) :-
    statute_defines_term_as_meaning(State, Year, Term, Meaning),
    !.

% Fallback: even if not explicitly defined, one could infer usage if a statute mentions the term
% in connection with the meaning. The provided statute does not mention the term at all.
legal_term_used_for_meaning(State, Year, Term, Meaning) :-
    statute_mentions_term(State, Year, _StatuteId, Term),
    nonvar(Meaning),
    fail.

% ---------------------------
% Answer predicate (deterministic)
% ---------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_year(Year),
    scenario_term(Term),
    scenario_meaning(Meaning),
    legal_term_used_for_meaning(State, Year, Term, Meaning),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

% ---------------------------
% Main entrypoint
% ---------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).
